description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for unassigning labels from an email within a Gmail backend system, including validation and schema annotations.

classes.name: UnassignLabelsRequest
classes.description: A DTO class used to request removal of labels from an email, containing a list of label IDs to be unassigned.

methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty unassign labels request.

methods.name: UnassignLabelsRequest
methods.description: Constructor accepting a list of label IDs to initialize the request.

methods.description: Setter method for defining the list of label IDs to be unassigned.
